purpose: Measure verified native group control flow with copied palette capture and real synchronous effect Begin replies
decision: Reject synchronous per-group worker handoff for runtime promotion: all 96 paired samples regress against the native bulk prototype

comparison.native_bulk: Existing native group/mesh bulk prototype with real local effect; not the complete installed beta.13 renderer
comparison.direct_capture: Same native group, copied palettes, independent consumer on the producer
comparison.worker_capture: Same capture with synchronous Begin result and bounded two-slot draw queue
timing_includes: state restoration on regular and extra frames
comparison.delta_definition: Each saved value is native minus worker in the same rotated round; medians are taken over paired deltas, not subtracted from separate medians

limits: Begin and pass callbacks are fixture-controlled native method virtual calls, not the complete native FX wrapper/source lifecycle.
Successful Begin HRESULT/pass count is real; failure is injected before calling Begin. No actual driver/lost-device failure recovery.
One supported pass and two independently created equivalent effect identities with fixed retained geometry/material resources; no arbitrary resource lifetime registry.
Native prepare/finish/compare callbacks remain controlled. Native decoded pose/matrix producers from the separate worker fixture are not integrated here.
Original native instancer and frame hooks remain on producer. Consumer ownership changes only between idle benchmark modes, not a live switching contract.
Group harness joins and cleans up its consumer but does not establish final zero-reference device release; the separate packet reset regression checks that contract.
All new paths are optional offline fixtures. No whole-scene/Present, gameplay FPS, multiplayer qualification or installation claim.
next_boundary: Investigate keeping effect lifecycle/results on producer and capturing owned GPU state/draw commands in larger batches; audit actual D3DX device calls and preserve explicit state restoration before claiming an asynchronous solution.
